    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f

    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')

      AND SalesQuantity > 0
),
po AS (
    SELECT pk, count() AS n
    FROM op
    GROUP BY pk
),
pairs AS (
    SELECT a.pk AS pk1, b.pk AS pk2, count() AS co
    FROM op AS a
    INNER JOIN op AS b
        ON a.order_no = b.order_no AND a.pk < b.pk
    GROUP BY pk1, pk2
)
SELECT
    p1.ProductName AS product_1,

FROM pairs AS pr
INNER JOIN po AS po1 ON po1.pk = pr.pk1
INNER JOIN po AS po2 ON po2.pk = pr.pk2
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p1 ON p1.ProductKey = pr.pk1

WITH
    orders_2009 AS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT SalesOrderNumber AS order_no
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
        WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')
          AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
          AND SalesQuantity > 0
    ),
    total_orders AS
    (
        SELECT count() AS n_orders
        FROM orders_2009
    ),
    contoso_order_products AS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            f.SalesOrderNumber AS order_no,
            f.ProductKey AS product_key
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
        INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
            ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
        WHERE f.DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')
          AND f.DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
          AND f.SalesQuantity > 0
          AND p.BrandName = 'Contoso'
    ),
    product_order_counts AS
    (
        SELECT
            product_key,
            count() AS order_count
        FROM contoso_order_products
        GROUP BY product_key
    ),
    pair_counts AS
    (
        SELECT
            a.product_key AS product_key_a,
            b.product_key AS product_key_b,
            count() AS common_orders
        FROM contoso_order_products AS a
        INNER JOIN contoso_order_products AS b
            ON a.order_no = b.order_no
           AND a.product_key < b.product_key
        GROUP BY
            a.product_key,
            b.product_key
    ),
    top_pairs AS
    (
        SELECT
            pc.product_key_a,
            pc.product_key_b,
            pc.common_orders,
            pa.order_count AS orders_with_a,
            pb.order_count AS orders_with_b,
            (pc.common_orders * t.n_orders) / nullIf(pa.order_count * pb.order_count, 0) AS lift
        FROM pair_counts AS pc
        INNER JOIN product_order_counts AS pa
            ON pc.product_key_a = pa.product_key
        INNER JOIN product_order_counts AS pb
            ON pc.product_key_b = pb.product_key
        CROSS JOIN total_orders AS t
        ORDER BY
            pc.common_orders DESC,
            (pc.common_orders * t.n_orders) / nullIf(pa.order_count * pb.order_count, 0) DESC
        LIMIT 10
    )
SELECT
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY tp.common_orders DESC, tp.lift DESC) AS rank,
    pa.ProductName AS product_a,
    pb.ProductName AS product_b,
    tp.common_orders,
    round((tp.orders_with_a * tp.orders_with_b) / nullIf(t.n_orders, 0), 6) AS expected_orders,
    round(tp.lift, 6) AS lift,
    tp.orders_with_a,
    tp.orders_with_b
FROM top_pairs AS tp
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS pa
    ON tp.product_key_a = pa.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS pb
    ON tp.product_key_b = pb.ProductKey
CROSS JOIN total_orders AS t
ORDER BY rank
turns.assumption: 未说明渠道，按约定使用线上销售；以销售行（SalesQuantity > 0）判定产品出现在订单中；提升度的订单总体为 2009 年全部线上销售订单，即提升度 = 共同订单数 ÷（含A订单数 × 含B订单数 ÷ 2009年线上销售订单总数）。

    INNER JOIN retail.DimEntity AS e2 ON toInt32(e1.ParentEntityKey) = e2.EntityKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimEntity AS e3 ON toInt32(e2.ParentEntityKey) = e3.EntityKey

pairs AS (

           dt.downtime,
           dt.outages,
           ss.sales,

    FROM store_downtime AS dt
    INNER JOIN store_sales AS ss ON dt.StoreKey = ss.StoreKey
),
store_corr AS (

        FROM retail.FactSales AS f
        INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS ds ON f.StoreKey = ds.StoreKey
        WHERE ds.EntityKey IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY entity_key
    ),
    chain AS (
        SELECT
            toInt64(st.EntityKey) AS store_entity,
            multiIf(ifNull(l1.EntityType, '') = 'State', toInt64(l1.EntityKey),
                    ifNull(l2.EntityType, '') = 'State', toInt64(l2.EntityKey),
                    ifNull(l3.EntityType, '') = 'State', toInt64(l3.EntityKey), 0) AS state_key,
            multiIf(ifNull(l1.EntityType, '') = 'Country/Region', toInt64(l1.EntityKey),
                    ifNull(l2.EntityType, '') = 'Country/Region', toInt64(l2.EntityKey),
                    ifNull(l3.EntityType, '') = 'Country/Region', toInt64(l3.EntityKey), 0) AS country_key,
            multiIf(ifNull(l1.EntityType, '') = 'Group', toInt64(l1.EntityKey),
                    ifNull(l2.EntityType, '') = 'Group', toInt64(l2.EntityKey),
                    ifNull(l3.EntityType, '') = 'Group', toInt64(l3.EntityKey), 0) AS group_key
        FROM retail.DimEntity AS st
        LEFT JOIN retail.DimEntity AS l1 ON st.ParentEntityKey = l1.EntityKey
        LEFT JOIN retail.DimEntity AS l2 ON l1.ParentEntityKey = l2.EntityKey
        LEFT JOIN retail.DimEntity AS l3 ON l2.ParentEntityKey = l3.EntityKey
        WHERE st.EntityType = 'Store'
    ),
    anc AS (
        SELECT 'Store' AS entity_level, c.store_entity AS entity_key, r.amount AS amount
        FROM chain AS c
        INNER JOIN store_rev AS r ON r.entity_key = c.store_entity
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'State' AS entity_level, c.state_key AS entity_key, r.amount AS amount
        FROM chain AS c
        INNER JOIN store_rev AS r ON r.entity_key = c.store_entity
        WHERE c.state_key != 0
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Country/Region' AS entity_level, c.country_key AS entity_key, r.amount AS amount
        FROM chain AS c
        INNER JOIN store_rev AS r ON r.entity_key = c.store_entity
        WHERE c.country_key != 0
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Group' AS entity_level, c.group_key AS entity_key, r.amount AS amount
        FROM chain AS c
        INNER JOIN store_rev AS r ON r.entity_key = c.store_entity
        WHERE c.group_key != 0
    )
SELECT
    a.entity_level,
    e.EntityName AS entity_name,
    sum(a.amount) AS sales_amount
FROM anc AS a
INNER JOIN retail.DimEntity AS e ON e.EntityKey = a.entity_key
GROUP BY a.entity_level, a.entity_key, e.EntityName
ORDER BY multiIf(a.entity_level = 'Group', 1, a.entity_level = 'Country/Region', 2, a.entity_level = 'State', 3, 4) ASC,
         sales_amount DESC
